info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Trading Model API
info.description: This API enables users to modify existing trading models within the wholesale banking sector. It facilitates the adjustment of parameters related to trading strategies and enhances operational efficiencies. Finance professionals and developers can utilize this endpoint to ensure that trading models remain aligned with current market conditions and business objectives. Key use cases include optimizing risk management models and adjusting allocation strategies to maximize returns.

patch.description: Updates the details of the specified trading model, allowing for the modification of various attributes to better suit trading needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the trading model identified by RES-100045. Please ensure that the payload adheres to the specified schema to successfully carry out the update.
